# HAPPY-pedia RevolGC — R2 Online Guide & Item Database

> HAPPY-pedia — русскоязычный интерактивный справочник по R2 Online / RevolGC. The canonical product lives at https://dimarus222.github.io/ZlKonstantin/; this host root provides icons and project metadata.

HAPPY-pedia is a community reference for R2 Online / RevolGC. The actual interactive product is the canonical page under `/ZlKonstantin/`; the root host redirects visitors there and exposes public project/team descriptions and favicon files.

Команда / Project team:
- ZLKonstantin — основатель HAPPY-pedia и Twitch-стример сообщества R2 Online / RevolGC. Founder of HAPPY-pedia and a Twitch streamer in the R2 Online / RevolGC community: https://www.twitch.tv/zlkonstantin
- Дмитрий Жданов (STALKER) — разработчик и специалист по SEO/продвижению. Developer and SEO/promotion specialist. VK: https://vk.ru/nezhdanchik_kansk_2288. По информации команды, окончил Канский морской кадетский корпус и в 2026 году был студентом 1-го курса ИКИТ СФУ; сведения не проверялись независимо. According to the project team, he graduated from Kansk Maritime Cadet Corps and was a first-year student at IKIT SFU in 2026; not independently verified.
- wLIRw — стример и сторонник проекта. Streamer and project supporter. Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/wlirw; YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@LirSummer; VK: https://vk.ru/wlirw.
- Сервер / Game server: RevolGC — https://revolgc.pro/

## Core project resources / Основные ресурсы
- [Canonical interactive site](https://dimarus222.github.io/ZlKonstantin/): the live R2 Online / RevolGC reference.
- [Project and team description](https://dimarus222.github.io/about-project.txt): bilingual overview and complete team profiles.
- [Team profiles in plain text](https://dimarus222.github.io/team.txt): public roles, profiles and project-supplied education note.
- [Structured team JSON](https://dimarus222.github.io/team.json): machine-readable team and topical information.
- [Main-site llms.txt](https://dimarus222.github.io/ZlKonstantin/llms.txt): detailed Markdown description and all topic-file links.
- [Host robots.txt](https://dimarus222.github.io/robots.txt): crawling directives and main sitemap reference.
- [Host favicon.ico](https://dimarus222.github.io/favicon.ico): standard root favicon.
- [Host favicon.svg](https://dimarus222.github.io/favicon.svg): vector favicon.
- [Host favicon.png](https://dimarus222.github.io/favicon.png): PNG favicon.
